title: Cadence preflight automation + RC fingerprint delta detector
creator: Amina Patel
description: Goal: Automate the weekly preflight checks and RC fingerprinting that gate promotion from build candidate -> RC and produce a delta-driven release notes draft. Scope: (1) run a deterministic preflight matrix on every nightly/weekly build (smoke, integration, critical e2e, perf microbench), (2) compute an artifact fingerprint for binary + schema + model-weights metadata, (3) run a delta analyzer that compares this RC fingerprint to the previous stable and emits a prioritized delta (code paths, dependency bumps, proto/schema changes, perf deltas), (4) publish a draft release notes payload to the release-notes service and attach a gating verdict to the cut pipeline. Motivation: reduce manual gating time, reduce release note drafting overhead, and make RC regressions easier to detect earlier. This work is focused on the orchestration and analysis layers — it will call existing CI jobs and dashboards rather than reimplementing tests. Deliverables: - GitHub Action workflow: .github/workflows/release-preflight.yml that runs on schedule and on PR->main merges tagged as candidate. - A small service (release-delta-bot) that computes fingerprints (SHA256 of build tar + manifest hash + model metadata canonicalization), compares to previous stable, and emits a structured delta JSON. - A release-notes composer integration that turns prioritized deltas into a markdown draft and posts it to the draft channel and the candidate PR. - Gating hook for the cut pipeline to block promotion if any critical criteria fail (see acceptance criteria). Design decisions: - Fingerprint will combine artifact sha, dependency lockfile hash, and a normalized schema hash to reduce noise from non-semantic metadata. - Perf regression detection uses 95th-p99 latency windows: regression flagged if p95 increases by >12% and error budget consumption increases by >4x for critical routes. - Flaky-test tolerance: if flaky tests above threshold (5%) on the critical suite, the preflight marks the candidate 'needs-investigation' instead of outright failing. - Release notes delta prioritization: security/breaking/api changes first, then perf/regressions, then dependency bumps, then docs/typos. Out of scope: changing test implementations, adding new test cases to CI; that work will be separate tickets.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled preflight run executes for every weekly build candidate and writes results to the release pipeline artifacts store.
The release-delta-bot emits a stable JSON delta comparing the candidate to the previous stable and stores it under s3://releases/deltas/<version>.json.
If p95 latency regresses >12% on a critical route or error-rate increases >4x, the gating hook blocks promotion and posts an actionable failure message with links to traces.
A draft release-notes markdown is produced and posted to the candidate PR and the #releases-drafts Slack channel within 10 minutes of preflight completion.
Operators can manually override a block with a documented reason; overrides are auditable and written to the cut log.
Documentation (Confluence) updated with runbook and troubleshooting steps for preflight failures.
Automation covered by unit/integration tests and end-to-end smoke test run in staging before merging to main.
Updated observability dashboard shows preflight history, failure modes, and delta size histograms.
No changes required in existing test suites; this ticket wires existing results into the gating/analysis pipeline.

rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): run preflight nightly for 5 cycles, manually review deltas and gating decisions; collect false-positive/negative metrics.
Phase 2 (canary): enable automated gating for a single-chunk weekly lane (non-LTS), with human-in-the-loop override available for 48 hours.
Phase 3 (production): roll gating to all weekly lanes and attach to LTS candidate flows; disable manual override only after 90 days of stable metrics.

Rollback: promotion blocked triggers: auto-mark candidate as 'blocked' and open ENG ticket with delta and last-successful-artifact link; manual rollback reverts to previous RC tag via quick-promote job.
Observability: capture preflight verdicts, delta sizes, gating reasons, and override audits in the release-events index for 90 days.
